meta.title: Triage of the 30 not-yet-directly-collectable KSIs
meta.purpose: Stage 1 output. Classifies each pending KSI as bucket_a (a read-only AWS API exposes the state, so a deterministic collector can gather it now) or bucket_b (the evidence is a document, artifact, or reviewed-within-interval process that needs a deployable AWS Config custom rule plus provider-produced evidence, and is NOT honestly collectable read-only from this repo).
meta.boundary_note: Bucket A collectors read posture and emit facts, never statuses. Bucket B is provider-deployed infrastructure, not a read-only collector; marking it collectable_now would be over-claiming and is refused.

bucket_a.description: Read-only describe/list/get exposes the state. Build as new collectors in collectors.py with offline fixture tests; each new API action is added to READ_ONLY_ACTIONS on purpose.

KSI-CMT-VTD.name: Validating Throughout Deployment
KSI-CMT-VTD.signal: CodePipeline stages include approval and test gates

KSI-CNA-RVP.name: Reviewing Protections
KSI-CNA-RVP.signal: WAF web ACLs and rate-based rules associated with ALB/CloudFront

KSI-CNA-ULN.name: Using Logical Networking
KSI-CNA-ULN.signal: Security group and network ACL posture (logical segmentation)

KSI-IAM-JIT.name: Authorizing Just-in-Time
KSI-IAM-JIT.signal: Short max session durations; no long-lived access keys for privileged principals

KSI-IAM-SUS.name: Responding to Suspicious Activity
KSI-IAM-SUS.signal: GuardDuty enabled; EventBridge rules and Lambda containment functions present

KSI-MLA-OSM.name: Operating SIEM Capability
KSI-MLA-OSM.signal: Org CloudTrail on; S3 archive with object lock; Security Hub enabled

KSI-PIY-RSD.name: Reviewing Security in the SDLC
KSI-PIY-RSD.signal: CodePipeline security stages (test, static analysis, scan) present

KSI-RPL-TRC.name: Testing Recovery Capabilities
KSI-RPL-TRC.signal: AWS Backup restore-testing plan configured and scheduled

KSI-SCR-MIT.name: Mitigating Supply Chain Risk
KSI-SCR-MIT.signal: Inspector scanning enabled for ECR and Lambda

KSI-SCR-MON.name: Monitoring Supply Chain Risk
KSI-SCR-MON.signal: Inspector continuous scanning and alerting pipeline enabled

KSI-SVC-PRR.name: Preventing Residual Risk
KSI-SVC-PRR.signal: Encryption, isolation, public-access blocks on data stores

KSI-SVC-RUD.name: Removing Unwanted Data
KSI-SVC-RUD.signal: S3 lifecycle policies, DynamoDB TTL, backup retention configured

KSI-SVC-VRI.name: Validating Resource Integrity
KSI-SVC-VRI.signal: ECR immutable tags/image signing; CloudTrail log-file validation enabled

bucket_b.description: Evidence is a document, artifact, or reviewed-within-interval process. Not readable from a plain API. Deliver as a deployable AWS Config custom rule plus a Lambda evaluation skeleton the provider installs in their own account. Registry stays collectable_now=false; a provider_deployed flag records that this is provider infrastructure, not a repo read-only collector.

KSI-CED-RAT.name: Reviewing All Training
KSI-CED-RAT.evidence: training-records object in S3, current within review interval, covers each audience

KSI-CMT-RVP.name: Reviewing Change Procedures
KSI-CMT-RVP.evidence: change-management procedure document reviewed within interval

KSI-INR-AAR.name: Generating After Action Reports
KSI-INR-AAR.evidence: after-action report object per closed incident within interval

KSI-INR-RIR.name: Reviewing Incident Response Procedures
KSI-INR-RIR.evidence: IR procedure and contact list reviewed within interval

KSI-INR-RPI.name: Reviewing Past Incidents
KSI-INR-RPI.evidence: incident-history data store (CloudTrail Lake or S3 archive) with required retention

KSI-MLA-RVL.name: Reviewing Logs
KSI-MLA-RVL.evidence: scheduled review queries and alerting rules exist and are enabled

KSI-PIY-RES.name: Reviewing Executive Support
KSI-PIY-RES.evidence: executive review artifact updated within interval

KSI-PIY-RIS.name: Reviewing Investments in Security
KSI-PIY-RIS.evidence: investment review artifact current within interval

KSI-PIY-RVD.name: Reviewing Vulnerability Disclosures
KSI-PIY-RVD.evidence: vulnerability disclosure program document and intake configuration current

KSI-RPL-ARP.name: Aligning Recovery Plan
KSI-RPL-ARP.evidence: recovery plan artifact reviewed within interval; recovery infrastructure configured

KSI-RPL-RRO.name: Reviewing Recovery Objectives
KSI-RPL-RRO.evidence: documented RTO and RPO reviewed within interval; backup settings match stated RPO
